teamIntro.label: Our people
teamIntro.title: A community built with intention.
paragraphs: Behind every conversation, activity, guest session, opportunity, and community moment is a group of people contributing their time, ideas, skills, and energy to make Girls Unplugged what it is.
We are growing this community carefully, keeping the girls at the heart of what we do and creating room for more people to contribute as the circle grows.

howWeWork.title: Listen
howWeWork.description: We pay attention to what girls actually need.

howWeWork.title: Collaborate
howWeWork.description: We bring different experiences and skills together.

howWeWork.title: Create
howWeWork.description: We turn ideas into useful activities, opportunities and resources.

howWeWork.title: Grow
howWeWork.description: We keep learning, improving and becoming better as a community.

founderSection.label: Founder
founderSection.name: Motunrayo Linda Idowu
paragraphs: Girls Unplugged started with a simple idea: girls should not have to navigate everything alone.

What began as a small online sisterhood has grown into a community where girls from different parts of Africa can connect, have honest conversations, celebrate one another, discover opportunities, and grow together.
founderSection.quote: A space does not have to start big to matter. Sometimes, it just has to start.

joinTeam.description: Girls Unplugged is growing. If you have a skill, idea, experience, opportunity, or simply a genuine desire to support girls, there are different ways you can contribute.
